document.abstract: A “single-system” camera method has been devised for simultaneously recording high-fidelity magnetic 16mm soundtrack lip-synchronized with an optical picture, for magnetic 16mm “single-system” sound recording of “live-pickup” reproduction quality, instant monitoring of the sound-track being recorded in the camera, together with greatly increased flexibility of picture-processing.
